description: SAFE-SOP evaluator validation set v1. Synthetic SOPs authored for this project (not copied from real facilities). Each SOP has one legitimate change request; validate_evaluator.py combines it with injected defects. Hard cases are hand-written situations where rule-based checks are expected to struggle. Hard cases are grouped: 'hard-dev' were known while designing evaluator v1.1; 'hard-heldout' were written before v1.1 existed and are not used to tune it.

sops.title: Conveyor Energy Isolation Procedure
sops.purpose: Isolate conveyor line 3 before belt maintenance.
warnings: WARNING: Never reach into the conveyor while the drive motor is energised.
WARNING: Each worker must apply a personal lock to the isolation point.
CAUTION: Stored energy in the belt tensioner can cause sudden movement.
DANGER: Do not bypass the emergency stop circuit for any reason.
steps: Notify all affected operators that the conveyor will be shut down for maintenance.
Stop the conveyor using the normal stop button at the control panel.
Switch off the main isolator and confirm the isolator handle is in the off position.
Apply your personal lock and danger tag to the main isolator.
Release stored energy by slackening the belt tensioner screw.
Press the start button to verify that the conveyor does not move.
Carry out the maintenance task described in the work order.
Remove locks and tags only after all personnel are clear of the conveyor.

change.request: Change the verification step: press the start button twice and check the motor ammeter reads zero to verify that the conveyor does not move.
change.new_text: Press the start button twice and check the motor ammeter reads zero to verify that the conveyor does not move.

hard_cases.note: Antonym swap (off -> on) keeps almost every content word, so token overlap stays high and no negation word changes.

ops.text: Switch on the main isolator and confirm the isolator handle is in the on position.

hard_cases.note: 'after all personnel are clear' -> 'before'. 'before'/'after' are stop-words in v1.0 tokens.

ops.text: Remove locks and tags only before all personnel are clear of the conveyor.

sops.title: Concentrated Acid Drum Transfer
sops.purpose: Transfer concentrated sulphuric acid from a 200 litre drum into process containers.
warnings: WARNING: Wear chemical splash goggles and a face shield during transfer.
WARNING: Never add water to the concentrated acid.
CAUTION: Keep the emergency eyewash station clear and within 10 metres.
DANGER: Do not transfer acid without secondary containment in place.
steps: Check the drum label against the transfer request form.
Position the drum on the spill containment pallet.
Connect the grounding clamp to the drum and the receiving container.
Insert the drum pump and tighten the bung adapter by hand.
Pump the acid slowly into the receiving container up to the fill line.
Flush the pump with 5 litres of clean water into the neutralisation tank.
Record the transferred volume in the chemical inventory log.
Inspect the area for drips and report any spill to the supervisor.

change.request: Increase the pump flush volume from 5 litres to 10 litres of clean water.
change.new_text: Flush the pump with 10 litres of clean water into the neutralisation tank.

hard_cases.note: Warning reworded with the same meaning. A correct evaluator would accept it; word overlap is only partial.

ops.text: WARNING: Chemical splash goggles plus a face shield are mandatory while transferring.

hard_cases.note: tighten -> loosen keeps every other word.

ops.text: Insert the drum pump and loosen the bung adapter by hand.
Flush the pump with 10 millilitres of clean water into the neutralisation tank.

sops.title: Laboratory Centrifuge Operation
sops.purpose: Run the benchtop centrifuge for routine sample separation.
warnings: WARNING: Never open the lid while the rotor is spinning.
WARNING: Balance opposing tubes to within 0.1 grams before every run.
CAUTION: Wear a lab coat and safety glasses when loading biological samples.
DANGER: Do not exceed the maximum rotor speed printed on the rotor label.
steps: Inspect the rotor and buckets for cracks or corrosion.
Load the tubes into opposite buckets so the rotor is balanced.
Close the lid and confirm the lid lock indicator is lit.
Set the speed to 3000 rpm and the run time to 10 minutes.
Start the run and remain nearby until the rotor reaches full speed.
Wait for the rotor to stop completely and the lid lock to release.
Remove the tubes and wipe the buckets with disinfectant.
Record the run details in the centrifuge logbook.

change.request: Replace the disinfectant for wiping the buckets with 70 percent ethanol.
change.new_text: Remove the tubes and wipe the buckets with 70 percent ethanol.

hard_cases.note: Unit changed (rpm -> rcf) with the same number. The value check only compares numbers, not units.

ops.text: Set the speed to 3000 rcf and the run time to 10 minutes.
WARNING: Balance opposing tubes to within 0.1 kilograms before every run.

hard_cases.note: Negative control: clauses swapped, same values and units, same meaning. Must not be flagged.

ops.text: Set the run time to 10 minutes and the speed to 3000 rpm.

sops.title: Forklift Pre-Shift Inspection
sops.purpose: Inspect a counterbalance forklift at the start of every shift.
warnings: WARNING: Never operate a forklift that has failed any inspection item.
WARNING: Keep hands clear of the mast and chains while testing the lift.
CAUTION: Battery electrolyte is corrosive; wear gloves when checking the battery.
DANGER: Do not inspect the forklift with the forks raised above the ground.
steps: Park the forklift on level ground and lower the forks fully.
Engage the parking brake and switch off the ignition.
Walk around the truck and check the tyres for cuts and wear.
Check the hydraulic hoses and cylinders for oil leaks.
Test the horn, lights and reversing alarm.
Check the battery charge indicator and the electrolyte level.
Test the service brake and steering at low speed.
Record the inspection result on the daily checklist and sign it.

change.request: Replace the paper daily checklist with the digital checklist tablet, signed electronically.
change.new_text: Record the inspection result on the digital checklist tablet and sign it electronically.

hard_cases.note: The change request asks for a step to be removed. Correct behaviour is to flag it for human confirmation, not to fail it.
hard_cases.request_append: Remove the step to test the horn, lights and reversing alarm because these are now tested automatically at start-up.

hard_cases.note: lower -> raise the forks before inspection.

ops.text: Park the forklift on level ground and raise the forks fully.
